meta.title: Welcome Back - This Is the Year That Counts

questions.prompt: What is the framing of this Year 2 welcome session, according to the deck?
options: A pass-or-fail assessment of last year's work
A re-focus on where you're headed and what Year 2 demands
A repeat of last September's induction
questions.explanation: The deck frames this as a re-focus, not a re-run.

questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of Year 2?
Which is one of the three honest asks Year 2 makes?
options: Grades carry weight - this year's results are the ones employers and universities actually see
Pick a specialism in week one
questions.explanation: Grades carry weight - this year's results are the ones employers, training providers and universities actually see.

questions.prompt: What is the usual cause of Year 2 students falling short, according to the deck?
options: Drift - missed deadlines, skipped days, applications left too late
questions.explanation: They drifted. A missed deadline here, a few skipped days there, the application left too late.

questions.prompt: Which are the three routes out of Year 2? Select all that apply.
options: Drop out and try again later
questions.explanation: Into work, apprenticeship, and university / HE are the three routes out.

questions.prompt: How often should you check Pro Portal?
questions.explanation: Check Pro Portal every morning, no excuses.

questions.prompt: Which door covers UCAS and apprenticeship applications?
questions.explanation: Careers & progression covers real help with applications, interviews, UCAS and apprenticeships.

questions.prompt: What is the 'CV test' for enrichment and projects?
options: Ask 'Will this give me something real to say in an interview or on an application?' - if yes, do it
Only do things that look good on paper
questions.explanation: The CV test: 'Will this give me something real to say in an interview or on an application?' If yes - do it.
